title: 'Quantum gravity' appears out of nowhere around 1972 as a blocking mechanism

tellings.quote: if you look and you do a Google engram search there is basically no hits on quantum gravity until around 1972.

plain: The research field called quantum gravity barely existed until about 1972, and then it appeared almost from nowhere. That is the claim of the researcher Eric Weinstein, who says on the show that a Google Ngram search, a tool that charts how often a phrase appears in books over the years, gives 'basically no hits on quantum gravity until around 1972.' He raises it as a sign that the field may have been set up as a blocking mechanism, a way to steer physicists away from gravity research that might lead somewhere sensitive.
